title: Junta size denominator identity
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$ be a Boolean function, with positive total influence $I(f)$. For real numbers $\epsilon,\eta>0$ and an integer $k\ge0$, define $\rho=\eta/(2+\eta)$ and $C=(2/\eta+1)^2$. Then $$\frac{I(f)}{\left(\frac{\epsilon}{I(f)}\right)^{1+\eta}(\rho^k)^2}=\frac{I(f)^{2+\eta}}{\epsilon^{1+\eta}C^k}.$$
hypotheses_covered: $f$ maps the sign cube to the signs
The total influence of $f$ is positive
